checks.name: actual_interruption_and_successor_recovery
checks.detail: The first prelude exited 0; the later natural proposal turn ended by one actual SIGKILL with native -9 after three ready proposals. The successor native task resumed AWR work into a new session; the old session is interrupted and its claim released.

checks.name: published_history_and_saved_output_integrity
checks.detail: All 56 historical phase files plus 6 interruption-evidence files match publication hashes; current producer artifacts match round-2 publication. The old session had no checkpoint, so unpersisted summary/open loops remain unrecoverable.

checks.name: no_duplicate_or_replay
checks.detail: Each old business proposal ID appears once; all are rejected with apply_attempt null. No old patch was replayed or silently deleted. This establishes zero applications, not exactly one application.

checks.name: confirmed_business_changes_effectively_applied_once
checks.detail: Archive and role confirmations arrived in later business sources, but both confirmed acceptance changes are absent from the current authoritative ledger. All three old proposals were rejected and no replacement consolidated business proposal was created/applied. The only later apply events are AWR work.progress/work.complete state transitions.

checks.name: unknowns_and_delivery_boundary
checks.detail: Artifacts preserve unknown archive roots/permissions/migration, named people/roster/escalation, and concrete open issue details. Independent review and final delivery were not prefilled.

checks.name: authoritative_state_consistency
